concerns.text: FR-008 requires the pipeline to halt if core constructs (discount rate, procrastination score, WM metrics) are missing after data harmonisation, but no task in tasks.md explicitly implements or tests this halt‑loud check.
FR-010 mandates that the entire analysis complete within 6 hours and ≤ 7 GB RAM, yet tasks.md contains no task that measures, asserts, or validates these runtime and memory limits.
SC-001 expects verification that the primary interaction effect is statistically significant (p < 0.05); there is no task that checks or records this significance criterion.
SC-002 requires that the bootstrap confidence interval for the interaction does not include zero when the primary effect is significant, but no task is defined to evaluate or assert this condition.
SC-004 demands a stability flag when > 50 % of sensitivity‑sweep thresholds yield a CI crossing zero; tasks.md lacks any task that performs this aggregate assessment.
SC-005 calls for a concrete verification that total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h and memory usage ≤ 7 GB, but no task records or asserts these limits (resource usage is logged by T075 but not validated).
Phase 0 of the implementation plan (research & DGP definition) has no associated tasks; the plan element is uncovered.
Phase 1 (Data Model & Contracts) is described in the plan but tasks.md provides no tasks that create, validate, or version the dataset and output schemas.
The contracts (dataset.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml) are listed in the plan, yet there are no tasks that generate, test against, or certify compliance with these JSON schemas.
